name: Camping 101: Leatherworking

angles.text: A tent alone does not make a complete camp. You also need to learn basic campfire craft, usually from a cooking trainer.

faq.answer: Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village teaches skilled leatherworkers to make camping tents.
faq.q: Who teaches leatherworkers how to craft a tent?

faq.answer: A well-made tent shields travelers from heavy rain and blazing heat, helping them rest and stay alert on the road.
faq.q: What is the purpose of crafting a tent?

aliases: can i pitch tent in city
faq.answer: You pitch a tent in the wilderness, away from town centers where locals object to camps.
faq.q: Where can a camping tent be pitched?

faq.answer: A proper camp also needs a campfire. A cooking trainer can teach you to build a basic fire.
faq.q: What else is needed to pitch a proper camp?

faq.answer: Indari Sunseam teaches the tent pattern after you have practiced leatherworking and shown proficiency in the trade.
faq.q: When does Indari Sunseam teach you the tent pattern?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village is where Indari Sunseam lives and works, teaching travelers to craft camping supplies.

sections.body: Traveling leatherworkers need sturdy gear made from hide and pelt. Once they learn the craft, they are sent to Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village. There, she teaches them to make a proper camping tent. It keeps travelers dry in heavy rain and cool beneath a blazing sun, helping them rest on long journeys.
sections.title: Shelter on the Road

sections.body: Townsfolk object when rough camps clutter their streets, so you pitch your tent in the wild. A campsite needs more than shelter; it also needs a warming campfire. Visit a local cook to learn basic firemaking before you set out.
sections.title: Wilderness Campsites

summary: A leatherworker’s travels lead to lessons in making a shelter for the wilds. In Shen'dar Village, Indari Sunseam teaches skilled craftsmen to stitch tents that protect travelers and give them rest on long journeys.
